services.name: Kayak & SUP Rentals
services.desc: Enjoy a unique kayak rental experience at our shop floating on the Willamette River. No boat transportation needed, launch directly from our docks. Kayak Rentals are quick and easy. Launch directly into the river from our shop located at the Marina one mile below Willamette Falls. Includes all the equipment you need (boat, lifejacket, PFD) to hit the water quickly and safely. Our staff will give you basic paddling instruction and orient you to the area and the best route to take to Willamette Falls. Call for reservations or just show up during our hours of operation. services.name: eNRG Kayaking
services.desc: eNRG Kayaking offers paddling instruction for all skill levels, from whitewater kayaking to raft guiding. We offer a variety of courses to help you get started or improve your skills. Our beginner kayaking courses cover the fundamentals of paddling, river safety, and hydrology. This minimizes risk of injury and turns paddling into a lifelong passion. Take one of our courses taught by instructors certified by the American Canoe Associationto learn how to kayak and raft guide. services.name: Tubing Center
services.desc: Welcome to the ultimate summer destination just 30 minutes outside of Portland! eNRG Kayaking offers river tube rentals perfect for relaxing self-guided floats down the scenic Lower Clackamas River. Escape the crowds and congestion of Barton to Carver for these great alternative trips close to Portland! A scenic, family-friendly float ending at Dahl Beach City Park. Perfect for relaxing, swimming, and cooling off from the summer heat. This route features convenient post-float transportation options via our shuttle service back to the put-in point.
